attempts.text: [{"name": "covis14_cos", "idea": "Symmetric 14-day history co-visitation within 5 events, counted once per session, keeping the top 50 partners per item by cosine (pair sessions divided by the square root of both items' session counts) so that rare items get specific neighbors instead of popular hubs.", "kind": "table", "level": "item_pair", "sql": "WITH h AS (SELECT session, item, seq FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 14*86400), d AS (SELECT a.session, a.item, b.item AS item2 FROM h a JOIN h b ON b.session = a.session AND b.item <> a.item AND b.seq BETWEEN a.seq - 5 AND a.seq + 5 GROUP BY a.session, a.item, b.item), n AS (SELECT item, count(DISTINCT session) AS ni FROM h GROUP BY item), p AS (SELECT item, item2, count(*) AS c FROM d GROUP BY item, item2 HAVING count(*) >= 2), q AS (SELECT p.item, p.item2, p.c, p.c / sqrt(CAST(n1.ni AS DOUBLE) * CAST(n2.ni AS DOUBLE)) AS cs FROM p JOIN n n1 ON n1.item = p.item JOIN n n2 ON n2.item = p.item2), r AS (SELECT item, item2, c, cs, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY cs DESC, c DESC, item2) AS rn FROM q) SELECT item, item2, CAST(c AS DOUBLE) AS tv_ns, CAST(cs AS DOUBLE) AS tv_cos FROM r WHERE rn <= 50;"}, {"name": "buy_cos14", "idea": "Items carted or ordered in the same 14-day history session at any distance, sessions with more than 100 bought items dropped, keeping the top 50 partners per item by cosine over buy sessions, with the number of sessions where both items were ordered.", "kind": "table", "level": "item_pair", "sql": "WITH e AS (SELECT session, item, max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS o FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 14*86400 AND event IN ('cart', 'order') GROUP BY session, item), s AS (SELECT session FROM e GROUP BY session HAVING count(*) BETWEEN 2 AND 100), b AS (SELECT e.session, e.item, e.o FROM e JOIN s ON s.session = e.session), n AS (SELECT item, count(*) AS ni FROM e GROUP BY item), p AS (SELECT x.item, y.item AS item2, count(*) AS c, sum(x.o * y.o) AS co FROM b x JOIN b y ON y.session = x.session AND y.item <> x.item GROUP BY x.item, y.item HAVING count(*) >= 2), q AS (SELECT p.item, p.item2, p.c, p.co, p.c / sqrt(CAST(n1.ni AS DOUBLE) * CAST(n2.ni AS DOUBLE)) AS cs FROM p JOIN n n1 ON n1.item = p.item JOIN n n2 ON n2.item = p.item2), r AS (SELECT item, item2, c, co, cs, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY cs DESC, c DESC, item2) AS rn FROM q) SELECT item, item2, CAST(c AS DOUBLE) AS tv_ns, CAST(cs AS DOUBLE) AS tv_cos, CAST(co AS DOUBLE) AS tv_no FROM r WHERE rn <= 50;"}, {"name": "wk_covis_wide", "idea": "Wider current-week co-visitation: items within 10 events of the session's last 10 distinct prefix items in target-week prefixes, counted once per prefix, carted or ordered partners weighted triple, integer recency weights (11 - rank), excluding prefix items.", "kind": "source", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH pi AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), li AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), lt AS (SELECT session, item, 11 - rp AS w FROM li WHERE rp <= 10), ki AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM lt), a AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq FROM sess x JOIN ki ON ki.item = x.item), pr AS (SELECT a.item AS src, y.item AS dst, count(DISTINCT y.session) + 2 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN y.event <> 'view' THEN y.session END) AS c FROM a JOIN sess y ON y.session = a.session AND y.item <> a.item AND y.seq BETWEEN a.seq - 10 AND a.seq + 10 GROUP BY a.item, y.item), sc AS (SELECT lt.session, pr.dst AS item, CAST(sum(pr.c * lt.w) AS DOUBLE) AS score FROM lt JOIN pr ON pr.src = lt.item GROUP BY lt.session, pr.dst), f AS (SELECT sc.session, sc.item, sc.score FROM sc WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sess z WHERE z.session = sc.session AND z.item = sc.item)), rk AS (SELECT session, item, score, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY score DESC, item) AS r FROM f) SELECT session, item, score FROM rk WHERE r <= 40;"}, {"name": "covis_2hop", "idea": "Two-hop co-visitation via tb_covis_any7: neighbors of the top 10 neighbors of the session's last 3 distinct prefix items, with integer rank and recency weights, excluding prefix items and one-hop neighbors, to reach items that direct co-visitation misses.", "kind": "source", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH pi AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), li AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), lt AS (SELECT session, item, 4 - rp AS w FROM li WHERE rp <= 3), ki AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM lt), h1 AS (SELECT c.item, c.item2, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.item ORDER BY c.tv_ns DESC, c.tv_nb DESC, c.item2) AS r1 FROM tb_covis_any7 c JOIN ki ON ki.item = c.item), s1 AS (SELECT lt.session, h1.item2 AS mid, sum(lt.w * (11 - h1.r1)) AS w1 FROM lt JOIN h1 ON h1.item = lt.item WHERE h1.r1 <= 10 GROUP BY lt.session, h1.item2), sc AS (SELECT s1.session, c.item2 AS item, CAST(sum(s1.w1 * c.tv_ns) AS DOUBLE) AS score FROM s1 JOIN tb_covis_any7 c ON c.item = s1.mid GROUP BY s1.session, c.item2), f AS (SELECT sc.session, sc.item, sc.score FROM sc WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sess z WHERE z.session = sc.session AND z.item = sc.item) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s1 m WHERE m.session = sc.session AND m.mid = sc.item)), rk AS (SELECT session, item, score, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY score DESC, item) AS r FROM f) SELECT session, item, score FROM rk WHERE r <= 40;"}, {"name": "trend_buy", "idea": "Trending buy items for every session: distinct target-week prefixes with cart plus double weight for order, plus distinct history sessions with an order in the last 2 days, top 300 items, excluding the session's prefix items.", "kind": "source", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH g AS (SELECT item, count(DISTINCT session) + 2 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN session END) AS c FROM sess WHERE event <> 'view' GROUP BY item), hh AS (SELECT item, count(DISTINCT session) AS c FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 2*86400 AND event = 'order' GROUP BY item), u AS (SELECT item, sum(c) AS c FROM (SELECT item, c FROM g UNION ALL SELECT item, c FROM hh) GROUP BY item), gr AS (SELECT item, c, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY c DESC, item) AS gr FROM u), gt AS (SELECT item, c FROM gr WHERE gr <= 300), x AS (SELECT t.session, gt.item, CAST(gt.c AS DOUBLE) AS score FROM sessions t CROSS JOIN gt), f AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.score FROM x WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sess z WHERE z.session = x.session AND z.item = x.item)), rk AS (SELECT session, item, score, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY score DESC, item) AS r FROM f) SELECT session, item, score FROM rk WHERE r <= 40;"}]
